title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 05 JULY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 05 July 2026. Several spells of showers will occur in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. A few showers will occur in Western and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Rathnapura, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
